newsitem.title: USA: Goldman Sachs names Turnbull to manage Australia.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs names Turnbull to manage Australia.

text.p: Goldman Sachs & Co said Tuesday it had appointed merchant banker Malcolm Turnbull as chairman and managing director of Goldman Sachs Australia and New Zealand.
Goldman Sachs, an investment banking and brokerage firm, said in a statement that Turnbull will oversee its business in the region from offices in Sydney, Australia.
Turnbull, founder of an investment banking "boutique" specializing in mergers called Turnbull & Partners Ltd, will assume the post on August 1, it said.
His partner, Neville Wran, former premier of New South Wales, will become a senior adviser to Goldman Sachs, it added.
